# IMDb Mobile

> > IMDb Mobile provides comprehensive entertainment information including movie and TV show databases, genre and subgenre exploration, trending titles, and film industry events.

The mobile version of IMDb offers streamlined access to the world's largest entertainment database, featuring detailed genre taxonomies from horror subgenres to anime categories, trending content like Sinners and 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple, and comprehensive event listings for film festivals and awards ceremonies worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Horror subgenres (Psychological Horror, Vampire Horror)
- Anime genres (Shōnen, action anime, Japanese animation)
- Trending movies (Sinners, The Bride!, Frankenstein, 28 Years Later)
- Action epics and adventure narratives
- Popular anime titles (Demon Slayer, Chainsaw Man, Jujutsu Kaisen 0, Attack on Titan)
- Film festivals and awards events
- TV show databases and listings
- Genre-based content discovery
- Young male audience content
- Supernatural and vampire-themed entertainment
- Japanese cinema and animation
- IMDb interest pages and curated collections

## Horror Genres & Subgenres

- [Horror - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000112/?ref_=ints_cat_12_in_i_5): Horror genre page featuring fear-inducing movies and TV shows
- [Psychological Horror - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000114/?ref_=ints_cat_12_in_i_7): Psychological horror subgenre with tension-driven films and shows
- [Vampire Horror - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000119/?ref_=int_sim_in_i_11): Vampire horror subgenre with supernatural bloodsucker-themed content

## Anime & Japanese Animation

- [Shōnen - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000206/?ref_=int_sim_in_in_i_7): Shōnen anime subgenre page featuring action-packed titles for young males

## Action & Adventure Genres

- [Action Epic - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000002/?ref_=int_sim_in_i_2): Action epic subgenre showcasing grand narratives and heroic journeys

## Events & Industry

- [All events](https://m.imdb.com/event/all/?ref_=int_nv_menu): Directory of film festivals, awards, and cinema events worldwide
